body_markdown:
After the barnstorming success of Marvel’s Spider-Man, Insomniac Games is taking on another fan favourite Marvel character with a brand new game based on the adamantium-clawed Mutant, Wolverine.


Now, Wolverine has been fully revealed with a brand new gameplay trailer and we're going to run over the release date.


Here's what we know.


## Marvel's Wolverine: When Does It Release? Answered


Showcased during the September 24, 2025 PlayStation State of Play; Insomniac Games revealed the first official look at the gameplay of Marvel's Wolverine.


Logan will be a brutal single-player game, and they're adhering to the ferocity of the comics throughout the game.


In regards to a release date, Insomniac Games has now confirmed that Wolverine will be released on PS5 consoles on September 15th, 2026.


> Let's cut to the chase: Marvel's Wolverine launches September 15, 2026.
